INSERT INTO folder (
            id, account_id, remote_name, remote_id, local_name, delimiter,
            subscribed, selectable, last_sync_at, last_uid, highest_modseq, uidvalidity,
            role
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT (account_id, remote_name) DO UPDATE SET
            remote_id      = excluded.remote_id,
            local_name     = excluded.local_name,
            delimiter      = excluded.delimiter,
            subscribed     = excluded.subscribed,
            selectable     = excluded.selectable,
            last_sync_at   = excluded.last_sync_at,
            -- `COALESCE(新值, 旧值)`：只有新值非空才推进游标，空值不得抹掉旧值。
            last_uid       = COALESCE(excluded.last_uid, folder.last_uid),
            highest_modseq = COALESCE(excluded.highest_modseq, folder.highest_modseq),
            uidvalidity    = COALESCE(excluded.uidvalidity, folder.uidvalidity),
            role           = excluded.role
